selection.selection_order: date asc, venue code asc, day 01/02/03, race 01..12; first 100 complete PRE parses
selection.integrity_note: The 100-race universe was frozen from PRE-complete candidates after excluding meeting IDs used by both prior 100-race batches. Dedicated result-page scoring occurred only after the universe/predictions were frozen. Historical source pages may themselves be outcome-bearing, therefore KR-015 retrospective classification is retained.

coverage_limitations: The deterministic first-100 PRE-complete rule produced only four independent meetings and was composition-skewed toward Yahiko and Aomori.
Exact 333.3m was not represented, so the prior repeated 333.3m weakness was not independently re-tested by this batch.
Kawasaki, Gifu and Toyama were not represented, so their prior venue-specific directional findings were not independently re-tested here.
scientific_findings: Overall frozen-B1a ranking performance remained in the same broad range as the first two 100-race batches; the 300-race aggregate is top1 32.0%, winner Top3 68.33%, weighted log loss 1.76177.
Venue-specific strong/weak labels are not yet stable: Aomori fell materially versus the first two batches while Yahiko improved materially on fully disjoint meetings.
The independent-meeting requirement itself was satisfied: prior meeting overlap was zero and there was no retune or post-result deletion.
Because subgroup coverage was incomplete, this batch is valid mixed/negative evidence and must not be post-hoc repaired or discarded.
non_claims: This does not justify live betting or automatic betting.
This does not justify venue-specific operational rules or subgroup retuning.
This does not independently confirm exact-333.3m weakness because no 333.3m race was selected.
This retrospective evidence is not prospective/live evidence under KR-015.
scientific_conclusion: The preregistered 100-race fully independent-meeting replication completed successfully and preserves broad overall B1a ranking performance, but it weakens the stability of earlier venue labels and leaves the exact-333.3m warning untested because of deterministic sample composition. The correct next step is not post-hoc repair of this batch; it is a separately preregistered coverage-balanced independent-meeting confirmation and/or immediate larger-scale historical expansion with subgroup definitions frozen before scoring.
next_gate: Preregister a coverage-balanced independent-meeting confirmation that explicitly covers key exact circumferences/venues without outcome-based replacement, then scale toward the existing ~2000-race substrate with frozen B1a and all subgroup definitions frozen before scoring.
